verses.text: Benjamin was the father of Bela, his firstborn, Ashbel, his second, and Aharah, his third,
followed by Nohah, his fourth, and Rapha, his fifth.
Bela's sons were Addar, Gera, and Abihud,
Abishua, Naaman, and Ahoah,
and Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
These were Ehud's sons, the heads of the families who lived in Geba and were taken captive to Manahath:
Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. Gera led them into exile and was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
Shaharaim had children in the land of Moab after he sent away his wives Hushim and Baara.
His wife Hodesh bore him Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, and Malcam,
as well as Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These sons were heads of their families.
Hushim bore him Abitub and Elpaal.
Elpaal's sons included Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod and its surrounding towns.
They also included Beriah and Shema, family heads among the people living in Aijalon. They drove the people of Gath away.
Beriah's sons included Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
Zebadiah, Arad, and Eder,
and Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.
Elpaal's sons also included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, and Heber,
along with Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab.
Shimei's sons included Jakim, Zichri, and Zabdi,
Elienai, Zillethai, and Eliel,
and Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath.
Shashak's sons included Ishpan, Eber, and Eliel,
Abdon, Zichri, and Hanan,
Hananiah, Elam, and Anthothijah,
and Iphdeiah and Penuel.
Jeroham's sons included Shamsherai, Shehariah, and Athaliah,
as well as Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.
These were leading men, heads of their families as listed by generation. They lived in Jerusalem.
The father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife was named Maacah.
With them lived his firstborn son Abdon, along with Zur, Kish, Baal, and Nadab,
Gedor, Ahio, and Zecher,
and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
Ner was the father of Kish, and Kish was the father of Saul. Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
Jonathan's son was Merib-baal, and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.
Micah's sons were Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was the father of Moza.
Moza was the father of Binea. Binea's family line continued through his son Raphah, then Eleasah and Azel.
Azel had six sons named Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were all his sons.
His brother Eshek's firstborn was Ulam, his second was Jeush, and his third was Eliphelet.
Ulam's sons were brave warriors and skilled archers. They had many sons and grandsons, a hundred and fifty in all. These all belonged to Benjamin's family.
